output.brief: The GET latency regression is most likely caused by the 2 Nov storage-node compaction tuning change (FC-7710), not the gateway 5.8 release. Evidence: in every cell the p99 jump followed the config push, not the gateway arrival. aps-3 received gateway 5.8 at 01:05 without the config push and its latency stayed at about 94 ms. A test rolling euw-1 back to 5.7 on 6 Nov left latency unchanged. On the storage nodes, compaction threads went from 2 to 6 and disk utilisation rose to 97%, which is the mechanism. Traffic growth (about 6%) and network problems were ruled out. Confidence is good but not certain: the backlog source (Orrin migration vs. a cold-tier sweep) is not yet attributed, and I have not checked the storage-side compaction metrics against a second cause. Do not roll back gateway 5.8. That would reopen the audited security fix and would not fix latency. Do not pause compaction, which would push nodes toward disk-full. Next, revert the compaction change in one cell first, watch p99 and disk utilisation, then extend the revert. Hold the Orrin rate limit until the 10 Nov attribution.
